title: 互动效价揭示奶牛社会网络中的对比结构
summary: 提出一种效价感知的社会网络框架，利用姿态计算机视觉分析奶牛视频互动，区分亲和与对抗行为。在商业农场数据上验证，自动与人工标签一致率82.8%，宏F1为0.872。发现聚合网络掩盖了行为组成，效价分层揭示不同网络结构，为福利研究提供新方法。
summary_en: A valence-aware social network framework uses pose-based computer vision to analyze dairy cattle interactions, distinguishing affiliative and agonistic behaviors. Validated on farm data with 82.8% agreement and macro-F1 0.872, it shows pooled counts obscure behavioral composition, offering new insights for welfare research.
